sourceEvidence.evidenceSummary: Argo acquired eight operating commercial and industrial solar sites from NuGen, including six in Massachusetts and two in New Jersey. The add-on expands Argo's distributed-solar platform to 196 sites and approximately 270 MW of operating capacity.
